name: Appiod

sources.title: Homepage — active app-review blog (posts through Sep 2026), iPhone/Android focus
Submit App for Review — Wufoo intake form plus paid Network Review offer ($249 for 10 blogs)

conditions: A free review is nominally possible via the Wufoo form / the AppMarketingPlus 'complimentary review' lead-gen offer; the prominently marketed path is the paid $249 Network Review across 10 blogs
requirements: Focus is mobile apps: iPhone/iPad apps and games, Android apps and games; a Web Applications category exists but is thin
Submission intake is a Wufoo form (amp2.wufoo.com/forms/w1jhochl1h88713) embedded on the submit page

Part of the AppMarketingPlus review network — same operator ring as apps400.com, appsmirror.com, webapprater.com, appsthunder.com, appslisto.com, apps4review.com, game400.com, gadget400.com, appsmamma.com, appstimes.in
preparation: App name, store link (App Store / Google Play) or web app URL
Short description and key features for the reviewer
Budget decision: free single review vs $249 Network Review (10 sites, 'widespread exposure')
workflow: Fill the embedded Wufoo form with app details
For the free route, follow the AppMarketingPlus 'complimentary review' link (appmarketingplus.com/promote-your-app-free-review-service/) — it is a lead-gen flow for a marketing agency
For paid: the Network Review is $249 and posts unique reviews on 10 partner blogs including appiod.com
Published reviews appear under the matching category (e.g. /category/iphone-ipad-app-reviews/)
watchFor: This is a paid-review farm ring — the 'free review' is a lead magnet for AppMarketingPlus; expect upsell email
Do not treat a resulting review as earned/editorial coverage
Recent posts are formulaic 'Top 5 apps' listicles — review depth is limited
Same review network as several other batch domains (apps400.com, appsmirror.com, webapprater.com) — do not count each site as an independent placement
countsAsLive: A review post naming the product is published on appiod.com under one of the review categories
unknowns: Whether the unpaid Wufoo submission alone results in a published review without engaging AppMarketingPlus
Price of a single (non-network) review — only the $249 10-site package is stated
